title: Ladybug, 500 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description A unique design Digital printing of the highest quality Decorated with a magnifying lens Lucky charm Since time immemorial, people have sought to unravel the knowledge about happiness. Adding it to your collection will not only make it a valuable part of your assortment but also bring a touch of joy every day. Allow yourself to experience happiness in its purest form!
